**Hint 2:** After computing the gradient, update \( $$	heta_0$$ \) using the formula:

where \( \alpha \) is the learning rate. Substitute the initial value \( 	heta_0**{(0)} $$=$$ $$1$$ \) and the computed gradient to find the new value of \( $$	heta_0$$ \).
